aiTeam.title: AI Team Builder
aiTeam.subtitle: Describe what you need in one sentence; AI proposes a member roster you accept, edit or reject one by one. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
aiTeam.requirementPlaceholder: e.g. a small team that researches, writes a report, then turns it into a one-page deck
aiTeam.requirementRequired: Describe what you want the team to do first
aiTeam.draftUnavailable: The AI team draft capability is not wired up yet (teams:draftTeam is unavailable), so no draft can be generated for now.
aiTeam.draftReady: Generated {n} member drafts — please review them one by one.
aiTeam.noReason: (the draft did not explain why this member was picked)
aiTeam.confirmHint: Only accepted members are saved; rejected ones are never written.
aiTeam.nothingAccepted: No member has been accepted yet
aiTeam.coverageInsufficient: This roster may not be able to get the job done — fill the gaps or adjust before accepting.
aiTeam.teamFieldsRequired: Team name and mission are required

complex.title: Complex Tasks
complex.subtitle: Pick a team explicitly for this task (no automatic routing). The run goes back to the current thread.
complex.goalPlaceholder: What should this team do this time?
complex.needThread: There is no active thread. Start one in “New Task” before dispatching.

scheduled.teamHint: The team binding is stored with the task; on schedule the main process runs it with that team's roster and budget (choose "No team" for the previous anonymous behaviour).
